title: Princess Y85
highlights: Vector fin stabilisers with zero-speed mode
Third control station in the cockpit
description:
This 2022 Princess Y85 is lying in Singapore, with twin MAN V12-1900 engines showing 709 hours (November 2025). A Sleipner vector fin system provides stabilisation underway and at zero speed.

She features a GRP flybridge hardtop with spa bath and crane, third-station controls in the cockpit, a FLIR night-vision camera, CCTV, underwater lights and a Miele wine cooler.
